provenance.quote: Post-hoc analysis of 29 patients with COVID-19-related ARDS from cohorts of two Dutch hospitals. provenance.quote: The decremental PEEP trial was performed within routine care as follows: first, PEEP was stepwise increased to 10 cmH2O above baseline clinical PEEP, with a minimum of 24 cmH2O. After a stabilization period of at least 60 s, PEEP was reduced by 2 cmH2O every 30 s.

crossover_order.value: Incremental to ≥24 cmH2O then decremental by 2 cmH2O every 30 s, usually to 6 cmH2O; the compared methods are analytic endpoints computed on the same trial, not applied in sequence.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: enrolment required Berlin ARDS. obese_population: mean BMI 33 (± 7) kg/m2 ≥ 30. timing_subgroup: PEEP trials initiated at a median of 1 day [0–3] after intubation, i.e. mostly within 48 h of the reference event (intubation), though the IQR extends to 3 days. ptp_target_subgroups: the study applies the positive end-expiratory PL,EE target (absolute Pes subtraction); the EIT-based methods do not use transpulmonary pressure targets. Note: the study was excluded at eligibility (balloon did not guide delivered PEEP), so subgroup flags are recorded for completeness only.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: The paper states: 'Data from part of the first cohort has been presented earlier in studies comparing PEEP guided by PEEP/FiO2 tables and EIT [22, 23]' (van der Zee 2020 Am J Respir Crit Care Med and Somhorst 2022 Crit Care). Those two reports are not in this review's candidate pool (not listed in studies/COHORTS.md or the manifest), so no overlapping_cohort_with entries are declared; if they are added later, the Erasmus MC part of this cohort overlaps them. Compared: author statements, institutions (Erasmus MC, Maasstad Hospital, Rotterdam), enrolment windows (March–October 2020 and March–December 2021), and COHORTS.md clusters (no match).
unclear_items: eligibility.criteria.balloon_guided_peep_titration — coded 'no': esophageal pressure data were used to compute the Positive PL,EE recommended PEEP analytically, but the delivered PEEP during the decremental trial was set by the EIT-based routine-care protocol, not by Pes; the Pes-based methods were not applied to the patients. Adjudicator may reasonably read the EIT-guided routine titration with simultaneous Pes as qualifying.

design.study_design — coded crossover_physiologic, but the compared 'conditions' are analytic endpoints computed on a single decremental PEEP trial, not conditions applied in sequence; sequence_position left null for all arms.

outcomes[high >10% overdistension or collapse].effect_estimates — the sentence '(p = 0.004 vs. EITCP (n = 2/29), EITACP (n = 2/29), EITLC (n = 3/29), p = 0.035 vs. Highest CRS (n = 8/29)), while Highest CRS resulted in more high values ... compared to EITCP and EITACP (p = 0.035)' makes the exact pairing of the two p = 0.035 values ambiguous; recorded as reported.

outcomes[ventilator_settings].data entries for eitacp, eitlc, highest_crs — numeric PEEP values for these conditions appear only in Figure 2 / supplementary Table S2 (not provided), so values are null here.
outcomes[transpulmonary_pressure].data entries for eitcp, eitlc, highest_crs — values appear only in Figure 3 / Table S2.
outcomes[overdistension].data entries for the five primary methods — values appear only in Figure 4 / Table S2.
design.countries — 'The Netherlands' inferred from the institutions in Rotterdam (Erasmus MC, Maasstad Hospital), not stated as a country list.
design.industry_funded — coded false from the funding statement 'Not applicable.'; no explicit funding source is named.

feasibility.n_placement_attempted / n_placement_successful — not separately reported; 65 EIT-based PEEP trials were reviewed and 29 patients included, but the number of balloon placements attempted is not given.

extraction_flags.general_notes: This is a post-hoc physiological comparison of seven PEEP-selection methods computed from a single decremental PEEP trial per patient; no patient outcomes (mortality, VFD, LOS) are reported. Supplementary Tables S2, S3 and Figures S2–S4 contain endpoint values not in the main text and were not provided.
